infobox.usage: Unlocks apartment 8 on the second floor of the Zmeisky 3 building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Zmeisky 3 apartment 8 key (Zm apt. 8) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the apartments at Zmeisky Alley 3.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to apartment 8 on the second floor of the Zmeisky 3 building at Streets of Tarkov. The entrance is on the backyard side.
